PLAN "Cycle-Aware Strength 12 Week"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength while respecting menstrual cycle flow window"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
